player_prompt.intro:
A yaaɓe {N} ɓe ɗon haɓɓe ɓe ɗemngal.
E ɗon ɓe, aɓe ina〘 [accept] ina ɗon haɓɓe *ɓe ɗemngal*, walla [continue] ina wata haɓɓe ɓe ɗemngal e ɗon ɓe ɗon haɓɓe ɓe ɗungu.
So a kaa wata haɓɓe, a yaaɓe haɓɓe ɓe ɗungu.
A ɓodi (reward = 1) **kuli** so haɓɓe a yaaɓe ko haɓɓe mɛɓɓugo ɗon haɓɓe ɓe.

outcome.summary: Kaɗa ɗon haɓɓe {value} e draw {draw_num}/{N}. Mɛɓɓugo ɗon haɓɓe ko {best}. {result}
